magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'BOND0053' save tag; validated by FUN_0802dddc 8-byte compare

fields.name: bond_magic_tag
fields.description: Save-system tag 'BOND0053' at header+0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802dddc reads 4 EEPROM blocks (save offset 0x00, 0x20 bytes) via FUN_0802e164 and compares bytes [0x00..0x08) against the expected tag; FUN_0802e228 rewrites the 0x20-byte header. Baseline logical bytes are 42 4F 4E 44 30 30 35 33.

fields.name: slot0_stat_0
fields.description: Slot 0 gameplay stat byte 0 (slot+0x0C); ROM default 0x17.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802d944 writes 0x17 to slot+0x0C during per-slot default init (called for each 0xA0-byte slot from FUN_0802d8dc); slot 0 base is save offset 0x20; covered by slot neg-checksum validated in FUN_0802dd00.
